title: FMRP 1C3 Western Blot (Millipore MAB2160) post-IP
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.crev3d
materials: HRP-conjugated goat-anti-mouse IgG, light-chain specific antibody
Visualize with ECL solution according to manufacturer's protocol

steps.title: Run tris‑glycine gel
steps.instruction: Prepare and run a tris‑glycine SDS‑PAGE gel according to standard conditions.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF
steps.instruction: Transfer the resolved proteins from the gel onto a PVDF membrane using a wet or semi‑dry transfer system.

steps.title: Rinse membrane in TBST
steps.instruction: Rinse the PVDF membrane in 1× TBST (Tris‑buffered saline with Tween‑20).

steps.title: Block with non‑fat milk
steps.instruction: Block the membrane in 5 % non‑fat milk prepared in 1× TBST for 30 minutes at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with anti‑FMRP 1C3 (Millipore MAB2160) diluted 1:4000 in 5 % non‑fat milk/1× TBST for either 1 hour at RT or overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse after primary incubation
steps.instruction: Rinse the membrane 5 times with 1× TBST, completing the washes over approximately 30 minutes.

steps.title: Block with BSA
steps.instruction: Block the membrane in 5 % IgG‑Free, Protease‑Free Bovine Serum Albumin prepared in 1× TBST for 30–45 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Add secondary HRP antibody
steps.instruction: Add HRP‑conjugated goat‑anti‑mouse IgG (light‑chain specific) diluted 1:10,000 in 1× TBST.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the secondary antibody for 1 hour at RT.

steps.title: Final TBST rinses
steps.instruction: Rinse the membrane 5 times with 1× TBST, completing the washes over approximately 30 minutes.
